name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The project hosts one of the largest undeveloped primary silver resources globally, with Measured and Indicated resources totaling 232 million tonnes containing approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold. The company is advancing Diablillos toward a construction decision while continuing exploration at the La Coipita copper-gold project in San Juan Province.
